summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Zubite.bg updated quiz flow with stage assessment and lead capture. All 12 requested features tested and verified. Fixed critical API URL configuration issue in .env.local.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED - .env.local had incorrect NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL pointing to old domain (bg-dentistry-hub.emergentagent.com/api) causing double /api path

passed_tests: Quiz 10 questions work correctly with updated scoring (0-5=early, 6-12=progressing, 13-20=advanced)
Result page shows correct band label 'Ранен етап' for early stage (score 0-5)
Result page shows correct band label 'Развиващ се етап' for progressing stage (score 6-12)
Result page shows correct band label 'Напреднал етап' for advanced stage (score 13-20)
Result page displays: headline, explanation, urgency (colored box), education block for all 3 stages
Lead form appears on result page with fields: Име*, Телефон*, Имейл, Град*, Кратко описание
City dropdown shows София and Пловдив only (as button selection)
Form submit button says 'Изпрати и получи 3 опции'
Trust text 'Без ангажимент...' appears below form
Form validation shows error for missing required fields (name, phone, city)
After form submission, success screen shows with correct Bulgarian copy 'Получихме твоите данни'
Success screen has 'Обратно към началото' button that navigates to homepage
NO automatic routing to /orthodontics or /implants pages after quiz - user stays on result page
Mobile responsive design working correctly on quiz and result pages (tested on 390x844 viewport)
critical_code_review_comments: MasterQuiz.tsx well-structured with 10 questions and proper scoring logic
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Result page correctly shows stage-specific content with colored urgency boxes (emerald/amber/red)
Lead form integrated directly on result page - no separate step needed
Form validation working correctly for required fields
Success screen shows proper confirmation message and navigation button
updated_files: /app/frontend/.env.local - Fixed NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL from old domain to correct preview URL
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quiz v2 with lead capture fully tested. Key test IDs: option-yes/sometimes/no (quiz answers), quiz-back-btn (navigation), input-name/input-phone/input-email/input-message (form fields), city-sofia/city-plovdiv (city selection), submit-btn (form submit), back-home-btn (success screen). Quiz has 10 questions with 3 answer options each. Three score paths verified: 0-5=early (green/emerald), 6-12=progressing (amber), 13-20=advanced (red). Form requires name, phone, city. Success screen shows 'Получихме твоите данни' with back button. IMPORTANT: .env.local was fixed - NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL must point to https://dental-stage.preview.emergentagent.com (not the old bg-dentistry-hub domain).
